title: Vaerion capability declaration (v1)
description: A capability is DECLARED before it can be requested (ADR-0004; no ambient powers). Declarations come from vaerion.yaml (humans) or extension capability manifests. A declaration states what a principal is ALLOWED TO ASK FOR — never a guarantee of yes: the broker evaluates every request and fails closed. Grants are ceilings that only ever narrow (monotonic narrowing).

principal.description: Identifier of the principal this declaration belongs to (CRN or stable id, e.g. crn_ext_<ulid> or an agent grant block name).

capabilities.description: Declared capability definitions. Each is a ceiling the principal may request within; the broker may still deny or prompt.

domain.description: Capability domain. v1 vocabulary: fs.read, fs.write, net.connect, exec.run, model.invoke, secret.read, tool.call, intel.query, research.index, research.fetch, journal.append, journal.read.

scopes.description: Glob-ish scopes within the domain. `*` alone matches all; otherwise prefix/path/host patterns (`prefix/**` matches any depth, `prefix/*` matches one segment). Must be non-empty: a capability with no scopes grants nothing.

rationale.description: Human-visible rationale for the declaration; surfaces in audit and review.
